CanonAdditions: The temple contains a lower passage beneath the altar leading to a network of channels.
The temple's barrier functions as a trap that draws corruption in and consumes it rather than just containing it.
The temple was built around springs where water used in binding rites entered clean and left without crossing the same ground.
A bronze plate map exists showing the temple, six smaller shrines, and a web of channels beneath the city.
The map indicates a route west beyond the outer wall ending at a symbol resembling a split crown.
The map shows a way station or second refuge near the western edge of the city.
A band of pale light exists in the lower passage connecting to the glowing runes around the temple entrance.
The Blight can turn the dead into weapons that can be commanded by whatever is outside.
Kaelen's magic can hurt the Blight.
The creatures inhabiting the water channels are flesh and blood, not Blight-Touched entities.
The creatures in the channel have too many legs and round mouths ringed with pale teeth.
Captain Mira survived the separation at the aqueduct and reached the Greyhaven road marker.
Bren would argue for searching if separated.
Sera would insist that two missing men are not worth losing six more.
Tomas would say nothing until everyone else had exhausted themselves, then choose the sensible path.
The old watchfort stands north of the current location where Mira would take the company if the rendezvous failed.
CanonChangesOverTime: Kaelen's eyes previously carried a faint green reflection since the courtyard; they are now clear again after the Blight was removed.
The barrier previously flickered and weakened; it now stands stronger after absorbing the Blight.
The creature previously appeared to be dying when Elias and Kaelen arrived; it is now feeding on the Blight.
Kaelen's magic previously fueled the Blight energy; it is now established that his magic can hurt the Blight.
WorldStateUpdates: Elias and Kaelen are currently in a drainage ditch beneath the western city wall.
The immense shape above the temple stands higher than surrounding roofs, black against clouds, crowned by shifting green lights.
Green lights have awakened in windows, streets, and broken towers throughout the city.
Elias and Kaelen are climbing from the ditch and crossing the first field west of the city.
The fog has swallowed the lower walls of the city.
Only the spires and the towering shape remain visible above the fog.

Elias Thorne wears leather armor.
Elias Thorne possesses a sword that is dull from disuse.
Elias Thorne knows the mechanics of the Blight fog danger better than anyone.
Elias Thorne is traveling with Kaelen.
Elias Thorne has an injured shoulder.
Elias Thorne has a cut palm.
Elias Thorne has a leg that threatens to buckle when he puts full weight on it.
Elias Thorne possesses a bronze plate map etched with lines showing the temple, six smaller shrines, and channels beneath the city.
Elias Thorne carries a gray salt jar.
Kaelen exists and is an established character.
Kaelen is a young man.
Kaelen possesses a brass gauntlet on his wrist, which is a relic from an era before the Blight.
Kaelen possesses a lantern.
Kaelen has magical abilities, including summoning smoke and creating shields of light.
Kaelen possesses a staff with a crystal that can emit blue or white radiance.
Kaelen has a wound in his side from which green corruption previously spread.
Kaelen's eyes are now clear without the faint green reflection.
Kaelen is exhausted and can barely stand.
Kaelen's coat is torn.

NarrativeStateUpdates: Elias and Kaelen have decided to leave the temple area and move west toward Greyhaven or the watchfort.
The seal in the courtyard has failed due to Kaelen opening it, causing the creature to break through.
Kaelen's magic was used to remove the Blight corruption from himself and Elias.
UnresolvedInformation: The specific location of the village with black spires is not provided.
Whether Mira left a sign at Greyhaven is uncertain, though Kaelen believes she did.
The exact nature of whatever lies below the temple and what it commands is not fully known.
The fate of Bren, Sera, and Tomas is unknown.
ExtractionWarnings: Ambiguity exists regarding whether the 'immense shape' above the temple is a single entity or a collection of corrupted creatures commanded by something else.
It is unclear if the map plate was made before the city or simply predates the current Blight era, though Kaelen states it was made before the city.
